content.question: What is the role of cross-attention in an encoder-decoder Transformer?
options: It lets the decoder attend to the encoder's outputs at every generation step, connecting the input representation to the generated output
It lets the encoder attend to the decoder's outputs during encoding
It replaces positional encodings in both encoder and decoder
It masks future tokens in the encoder
content.answer: It lets the decoder attend to the encoder's outputs at every generation step, connecting the input representation to the generated output
